text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on my break, taking a stroll in the central plaza when…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's important to do more than just eat chanko. Like, you could… Oh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You could hang from a horizontal bar and have someone pull on your legs!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's not a bad idea! Let's see, what else is good?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi there, Trainer! You're just the person I wanted to see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, actually…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I have to know, Bono! What must I do to grow big and tall?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, what's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I want to become a cool and mighty hero! And that's why I want to get big!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I don't care how tough the training is! I can endure it, so please! You've gotta teach me your ways!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you've got to eat lots of food! That's the best way for sure. ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I already am eating a lot! I always finish everything I'm served.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I'm just not getting any bigger… Is there anything I can do?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And that's the long and short of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So I've been trying to come up with different methods, but I just can't settle on what to suggest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, do you have any ideas about what she can do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growing bigger and taller doesn't equate to becoming cool or mighty, though. When it comes to what a hero truly needs…
choice_data_list: She could try building her tolerance?
Perhaps she should temper her spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain how it's not necessarily Biko Pegasus's body that needs to grow bigger, but her heart and mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that makes sense! So it's not just about her eating more, but about eating things she doesn't like too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko does tend to pile her plates up with the foods she likes…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll get cooking with all the stuff she hates, like celery, bell peppers, and parsley. And I'll make them real tasty, so she'll eat up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A cloth sheet has been laid open on the rooftop, and on it sit plates of celery tempura and stuffed bell peppers, among various other dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer taught me that what a hero needs is tolerance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The reason I grew up big and tall is because I'm not picky about what I eat, even if it's food I don't like!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Uuurgh! Everything smells good, but…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guh! A hero's path is truly steep and arduous!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You can do it, Biko! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Biko Pegasus steels herself, Hishi Akebono happily announces that she's expanded her cooking repertoire even more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm… But how is she supposed to temper her spirit?
choice_data_list: Maybe by learning how to endure and never give up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, never giving up! I know a thing or two about that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Sumo wrestlers cling on until the bitter end, no matter how tough the going gets! Nope, they never give up…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: No matter how big a pot of chanko they're served!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's all about staying strong no matter how difficult things get, and finishing your food without leaving any leftovers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay! That's definitely something I can help her with! Thanks for the advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A cloth sheet has been laid open on the rooftop, and on it sit enough plates of food for an enormous banquet…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: If you want to be a hero, you can't ever give up! And there's still loads of food left, so let's clean these plates!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Urk…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now let's dig in! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't possibly let them eat such an excessive amount. After telling them to wait, I invite some other students over, and we all have a great time finishing the food together.
